notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
Added simple notes and a help email (reportmybug@gmail.com)

Known bugs added to backlog:
Datacubing from a post node may not always work
Windowed mode needs a fix

Dev note:
Thank you for trying my software. This simulation may be difficult to grasp, but I will keep developing it and its partner app WonderMatrix. Currently my PC is below the requirements so it makes development tedious, but I will continue the work more deeply after the new year. Please submit your requests so that I can prepare/improve. 

Thank you again. 
S.W
